title: Sommelier cellars / gravity module: no extractable residual — gravity balance is 1:1 bridge collateral, cellarfees below threshold, community pool capture closed, cork cellars are depositor vaults with an EOA authority
closed_reasons: Gravity module escrow (36,864,615.016774 SOMM, $12,687.47 paper) is the exact 1:1 backing of the Ethereum ERC-20 SOMM total supply (36,864,615,016,774 at 6 decimals, eth_call block 26,155,618) — bridge collateral, not residual: cosmos-originated bridge-outs lock usomm in the module account and bridge-ins release it; no unprivileged path moves it.

No pending bridge state exists to exploit or cancel: unbatched SendToEthereum store prefix 0x07 is empty (0 entries); outgoing-tx prefix 0x06 contains only 72 SignerSetTx and no BatchTx/ContractCallTx; last send ID 858 / batch nonce 805; last SOMM batch created at height 23,353,970, last WETH at 24,586,140 (outgoing path dormant ~3.6M blocks).

The only relevant gravity bug (GHSA-4vf2-m5pw-3r3r — batch timeout cleanup could cancel/re-queue already-paid-out txs, escrow double-spend) is fixed in gravity-bridge v6.1.0 and the live chain runs sommelier v10.0.2.
Gravity module funds are not gov-movable: no gov message spends a module account; CommunityPoolEthereumSpendProposal spends only the community pool (feePool), not the gravity escrow.

Cellarfees module holds only $2,169.00 (1,551.368 USDC + 0.15 stETH + 5.806 FRAX + 0.143 USDT) — below its $10,000 auto-auction threshold; proceeds_portion=1.0 sends the balance to a hard-coded 2-of-2 multisig somm1rvu9w27sstm2z7jgyq7kll0hfj4fdhsgnw0tat; not redirectable by gov and not takeable by anyone.

Community pool 110,069,732.502057 SOMM (~$37,882.02 paper) is gov-only and capture is closed: live gov params quorum=0.5/threshold=0.5/veto=0.334 (ABCI gov store h 28,183,210); solo capture >= bonded 71,464,846.36 SOMM (~$24,595.61 paper) while all public DEX float is 2,094,342 SOMM = 2.93% of need (no CEX); v10 PoA bloc (Foundation + 3 validators, power floor 0.67) ~73.94% veto-proof; CP DEX exit ~$0.5-1k (C2-08 corrected economics).

Cork-managed cellars (36 Ethereum + 6 L2) hold ~$1,186,275 of depositor vault value (Ethereum $996,443.70, Arbitrum $158,016.68, Optimism $31,814.82, Scroll dust) — self-service depositor withdrawals (H-O), not protocol residual; scheduling is authority-gated (fail-closed) to a single EOA somm1lcsjy2d5s33h0sddd8lpuqvwyz5ruz7ju4aeqa and no corks are scheduled on any chain.
Auction, axelarcork, pubsub, fee_collector and gov module accounts are empty at the pinned height.

Corpus correction: the tracker's 'cork cellars $209,492' prior figure is not reproducible from the live managed-cellar list; live gross is ~$1.19M (depositor funds). The 'gravity module dust' label understates the balance (36.86M SOMM) but is correct on extractability: the balance is bridge collateral.
caveats: USD values are paper values at the live DefiLlama SOMM price; realizable SOMM exit for large balances is far lower (DEX float 2.09M SOMM, C2-08).
Cellar TVL (~$1.19M) is depositor-owned vault value; what the CorkAuthority key could actually move depends on each cellar's code (not audited in this bounded entry).
Blockscout rate-limited the CI re-scan of Arbitrum cellars (HTTP 403); Arbitrum/Optimism figures are from the session-time scan (analysis/local/raw/), consistent with DefiLlama per-chain TVL.
sommelier-3 public LCDs do not serve /cosmos/gov/v1/params; gov params were read from the gov store via ABCI and match C2-08's verified quorum.
Historical sommelier-3 state is pruned on public nodes; all balances are single-height snapshots (heights recorded).
No fork PoC is applicable (Cosmos module accounting, not an EVM path); verification is live state + exact-version source + CI evidence run.
one_liner: External unprivileged attacker can extract $0.00 live from Sommelier's gravity module / cellars: the 36.86M SOMM 'gravity dust' is the exact 1:1 bridge collateral for the ERC-20 SOMM supply with zero pending sends/batches and the one relevant bug patched in v10.0.2; cellarfees ($2,169) are below the $10k auto-flow threshold to a fixed multisig; the community pool (110.07M SOMM, $37.9k paper) is gov-only with capture closed (2.93% of solo need on-chain, PoA bloc veto-proof); the ~$1.19M of cork-managed cellars is depositor vault value behind a dormant single-EOA authority — no E-U path exists.
